verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes API versioning, semantic-versioning guarantees, or a documented deprecation policy for the Agent SDK; documentation covers features (hooks, subagents, sessions, permissions) but not version/lifecycle commitments. Community reports even describe abrupt, undocumented changes to CLI/API access (e.g., 'Claude subscription' usage restrictions appearing without warning), reinforcing the absence of a stated deprecation process.
